audit.why: You out-stick her from 2-5 and she reclaims the lane at two items; that matches a 1025-range Q on 11s against your boomerang and the Harrier attack-speed scaling.
audit.corrected: Read stands; the reveal interaction below was the gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is called her panic button with no cooldown, so 'wait for it to be down' has no timer.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s — at rank 1 a spent Vault gives you twelve seconds where she cannot disengage your swing. Blinding Assault is 11s and Heightened Senses 50/45/40/35/30s.
audit.corrected: A spent Vault (12s at rank 1) is a twelve-second window where your all-in cannot be cancelled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heightened Senses reveals a large area — the direct counter to Going Rogue — and is never mentioned.
audit.why: Quinn's W actively sends Valor to reveal a wide area on a 50/45/40/35/30s cooldown, which strips Akshan's camouflage on a roam or a brush reset. Vault also explicitly interrupts on the leap-off, which is why it cancels Heroic Swing mid-arc.
audit.corrected: Heightened Senses reveals a wide area and finds you through Going Rogue — roam when it's on cooldown; Vault's leap-off is an interrupt, which is what cancels your swing.

edits.before: Her E (Vault) is her panic button and your biggest threat: it dashes in to knock you away, interrupting your Heroic Swing mid-arc so she escapes your all-in.
edits.after: Vault (12s at rank 1) is her panic button and your biggest threat: it dashes in and its leap-off interrupts, cancelling your Heroic Swing mid-arc so she escapes the all-in.

edits.before: Match your poke with Blinding Assault (Q) to nearsight you and her own auto poke, then roam on her R Behind Enemy Lines while waves are even
edits.after: Match your poke with Blinding Assault, sweep you out of Going Rogue with Heightened Senses, then roam on her R while waves are even

edits.before: Bait her E Vault, then commit Heroic Swing and R the instant she's used it so she has no knockback left to interrupt you
edits.after: Bait Vault, then commit Heroic Swing and R inside its 12 seconds of downtime, when she has no interrupt left

edits.before: These are your strongest pure-laning levels: she has only the Vault to interrupt your Q-E chip, and once it's down she can't disengage.
edits.after: These are your strongest pure-laning levels: only Vault interrupts your Q-E chip, and inside its 12s downtime she cannot disengage at all.

edits.before: This is your lane. Through 4-5 your Heroic Swing gives you a poke-and-escape she can't match, and every Q champion-hit feeds your move speed so she can't simply Harrier-kite away. At 6 your R (Comeuppance) is a missing-health execute on a low Quinn, so the pattern is bait the Vault, swing in, Q the sweetspot, then R to finish — and the takedown resets your E to 0.5s so you can swing straight to the next play. The trap is committing your Heroic Swing while her Vault is up; if she still has E, she dashes in and knocks you out of the arc, so poke instead of all-in until you see it on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your lane. Through 4-5 your Heroic Swing gives you a poke-and-escape she can't match, and every Q champion-hit feeds your move speed so she can't simply Harrier-kite away. At 6 your R is a missing-health execute on a low Quinn, so the pattern is bait the Vault, swing in, Q the sweetspot, then R to finish — and the takedown resets your E to 0.5s. The trap is committing while Vault is up; its leap-off interrupts, so it knocks you clean out of the arc. Roaming, remember Heightened Senses reveals a wide area and finds you through Going Rogue.

notes: Heightened Senses' area reveal was absent everywhere and it is the specific answer to Akshan's camouflage roams — worth tracking its 50s rank-1 cooldown before leaving lane.
